verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents ingesting error data from Sentry's open-source SDKs and claims Sentry API compatibility. Its own CLI uploads native debug symbols (dSYM, ELF, PDB), which points to symbolicated native crash support for iOS and Android/NDK builds. However, no evidence names iOS, Android, or NDK SDKs explicitly, and none shows device, OS, or app-version context being surfaced. Missing for 10: explicit iOS/Android/NDK crash-capture docs, evidence of device/OS/app-version context in events, hands-on or independent corroboration of native mobile crash handling.
